Why: after n inserts a given bit is still 0 with prob (1−1/m)^(kn) ≈ e^(−kn/m), and a false positive needs all k probed bits to be 1. Tuning lever: bits per item, m/n (give it more bits). For a fixed m/n the best hash count is k = (m/n)·ln 2, which gives p ≈ 0.6185^(m/n
